Name: ChestItemFinder
Author: cynthiazhao0411
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
ChestItemFinder helps you find which chest holds the item you're looking for. Open a search box, and matching chests pulse in the world. An on-screen message tells you how many chests were found and in which locations. Built for late-game farms where you have too many chests to remember what's in each one.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download the zip and extract the ChestItemFinder folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Load a save and press LeftShift + (default key) to open the search box. Type the item name and press Enter.
*(You can change the search key in `config.json` or in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.)*


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Search all chests in every location, including building interiors (sheds, barns) and Ginger Island.[/*]
[*]Press LeftShift + T to open a clean in-game search box instead of typing console commands.[/*]
[*]Advanced Smart Matching:[/*]
[*]P1 Category Macro (e.g. fruit, fish) finds all items in that category.[/*]
[*]P2 Multi-word Categories (e.g. artisan goods).[/*]
[*]P3 Exact Match (e.g. star fruit) highlights precisely without matching wines/jellies.[/*]
[*]P4 Fuzzy Fallback (e.g. star) finds everything with that root.[/*]
[*]Number ID Search: Type an item or category ID (e.g. -2 for all gems, 268 for Starfruit) to search directly.[/*]
[*]Quality Filter System: Click the star button next to the search box to cycle quality (Silver, Gold, Iridium, All). Items without quality (like wood) ignore this filter.[/*]
[*]Hover Tooltip & Pause: Hover over location text (like "Farm") to see exact item counts in those chests. Hovering over the UI pauses the highlight countdown.[/*]
[*]Anti-spam protection: Blocks text searches with less than 3 characters.[/*]
[*]Highlights automatically clear after you open any target chest or when the timer runs out.[/*]
[*]Fully customizable via GMCM: 10 highlight colors, opacity slider (0% to 100%), and custom keybind.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, to change the default H keybind in-game)
